story.title: The Great Turnip Tricycle Debacle
story.question: How did Silas sell his vegetable carriage?
story.answer: By launching it wildly into the town square.

story_beats.headline: The Secret Prototype
story_beats.speech: Behold the root-powered rocket rig! It transforms ordinary turnips into pure propulsion for our bustling market.
story_beats.label: The Invention
story_beats.visual_prompt: An eccentric inventor named Silas wearing a tweed vest stands proudly in a busy cobblestone market holding a greasy blueprint, pointing at a strange mechanical cart powered by turnips with a glowing gear icon overhead.

story_beats.headline: Gathering Fuel
story_beats.speech: We must cram every single purple root into the combustion chamber before the noon bell rings loudly.
story_beats.label: Loading Cargo
story_beats.visual_prompt: Silas's nervous apprentice Barnaby wearing patched overalls frantically stuffs giant purple turnips into a smoking brass hopper on the back of the tricycle in the crowded town square.

story_beats.headline: The Mechanical Launch
story_beats.speech: Pull the brass lever now and watch those root vegetables propel us straight past the apple stall!
story_beats.label: The Ignition
story_beats.visual_prompt: Silas and Barnaby hang on desperately to the handlebars as the tricycle shoots forward in a cloud of vegetable steam, scattering surprised market vendors and flying cabbages everywhere.

story_beats.headline: Market Success
story_beats.speech: Every single shopper wants a vegetable vehicle now! Our messy launch became our greatest marketing victory.
story_beats.label: Grand Finale
story_beats.visual_prompt: Silas stands smiling beside his parked tricycle while a long queue of cheerful townspeople wave gold coins at him outside a bustling local produce shop.

visual_bible.style: Bright, colorful claymation stop-motion aesthetic with expressive character animations.

characters.Silas: An energetic middle-aged inventor with wild gray hair, round spectacles, a tweed vest, and flour-stained trousers.
characters.Barnaby: A lanky teenage apprentice with a crooked cap, wide eyes, patched denim overalls, and muddy boots.

locations.Market Square: A bustling medieval-style town plaza filled with colorful striped awnings, wooden stalls, and cobblestone pathways.

objects.Tricycle: A bizarre three-wheeled contraption made of polished copper pipes, a brass hopper, and wooden bicycle parts.
objects.Turnip: An oversized, vibrant purple root vegetable with bushy green leafy tops.

story.title: The Resonance Valve Rebellion
story.question: Can the crew bypass the vocal lock before the acoustic pressure seals them out forever?
story.answer: Yes, by harmonizing their individual heartbeats with the core's manual override.

story_beats.headline: The Silent Deck
story_beats.speech: We cannot wait for mission control. The resonant valve is jamming and we need to purge the main intake right now.
story_beats.label: Intake Breach
story_beats.visual_prompt: Commander Vex, a tall cybernetic human with silver skin and orange jumpsuit, stands inside the claustrophobic titanium bridge holding a flashing diagnostic pad, staring at a frozen red warning console.

story_beats.headline: Disputed Frequencies
story_beats.speech: Your manual purge will crack the seals! We must recalibrate the audio sensors instead of risking total hull decompression.
story_beats.label: Sensor Dispute
story_beats.visual_prompt: Engineer Dax, a stout human with a copper-tinted visor and green utility vest, points accusingly at the central holographic display showing erratic yellow waveform spikes inside the dimly lit engine bay.

story_beats.headline: The Harmonic Choice
story_beats.speech: There is no time to argue! Align your biometric transmitters to the primary conduit or this bulkhead becomes our tomb.
story_beats.label: Core Override
story_beats.visual_prompt: A squat maintenance robot with a single glowing blue optical lens holds open a sparking maintenance hatch, exposing a pulsing crimson pipe while Vex and Dax press their palms against the biometric pads.

story_beats.headline: Resonant Harmony
story_beats.speech: The pressure is stabilizing. By tuning our heartbeats together, we finally saved the ship from structural collapse.
story_beats.label: Stable Orbit
story_beats.visual_prompt: Vex and Dax stand side by side gazing through the panoramic viewport at a peaceful turquoise planet, holding empty diagnostic pads while a calm green indicator light glows steadily above the hatch.

visual_bible.style: Clean sci-fi industrial aesthetic with practical lighting, metallic textures, and vibrant holographic interfaces.

characters.Vex: Tall cybernetic human with polished silver skin, sharp angular proportions, wearing a form-fitting orange utility jumpsuit.
characters.Dax: Stout human engineer with a copper-tinted visor, broad shoulders, wearing a rugged green canvas vest and dark trousers.

locations.bridge: Claustrophobic titanium bridge filled with glowing red warning consoles and a large panoramic viewport.
locations.engine_bay: Dimly lit industrial chamber featuring exposed conduits, a sparking maintenance hatch, and a central holographic display.

objects.diagnostic_pad: A rectangular slate of brushed dark metal featuring a bright orange liquid-crystal display showing telemetry data.
objects.biometric_pad: A circular wall-mounted plate made of brushed steel with a recessed black handprint scanner that glows blue when active.

story.title: The Weaver's Last Thread
story.question: Can true friendship survive the burden of a secret legacy?
story.answer: Yes, but only when loyalty proves stronger than personal ambition.

story_beats.headline: A Hidden Discovery
story_beats.speech: Look closely at this ancient loom, Thomas. My grandfather sealed these blueprints inside the wooden frame before he vanished.
story_beats.label: The Sealed Workshop
story_beats.visual_prompt: Elmer stands nervously by a heavy oak workshop door, holding a dusty parchment scroll in his right hand. He wears a dark wool tunic and has a worried expression. Soft candlelight illuminates the rustic interior.

story_beats.headline: The Tempting Offer
story_beats.speech: If we submit these designs to the royal guild tonight, our village will prosper and our names will echo forever.
story_beats.label: The Crossroads
story_beats.visual_prompt: Thomas and Elmer stand near a dense pine forest boundary under moonlight. Thomas gestures toward a distant castle silhouette while holding a leather pouch, wearing an ambitious smile and a green leather jerkin.

story_beats.headline: The Broken Trust
story_beats.speech: You cannot trade our peace for gold, Thomas. The guild will exploit this craft and destroy everything we cherish.
story_beats.label: The Warning Fire
story_beats.visual_prompt: Elmer stands resolute beside a blazing signal fire on a windy hill, pointing an accusing finger at Thomas. Sparks drift into the night sky, and Elmer's blue cloak whips violently in the harsh gale.

story_beats.headline: The Silent Sacrifice
story_beats.speech: Then we burn the plans together, old friend. Our bond is worth far more than any crown or kingdom.
story_beats.label: The River Bank
story_beats.visual_prompt: Thomas and Elmer stand side by side on a muddy river bank, watching burning parchment ashes float away toward a moored wooden fishing boat. Both men wear warm expressions of renewed mutual respect.

visual_bible.style: Realistic historical illustration with warm cinematic lighting and rich earthy textures.

characters.Elmer: A humble village weaver in his late forties with weary brown eyes, short graying hair, and wearing a durable dark wool tunic.
characters.Thomas: An ambitious fellow villager with bright green eyes, neatly combed dark hair, and wearing a tailored green leather jerkin.

locations.The Sealed Workshop: A rustic stone cottage interior cluttered with spools of thread, wooden beams, and a large unused loom.
locations.The River Bank: A quiet misty river edge bordered by tall reeds and the silhouette of a small wooden fishing boat.

objects.Blueprint Scroll: A yellowed parchment roll tied securely with frayed hemp twine and covered in intricate ink diagrams.
objects.Signal Beacon: A tall stack of dry pine logs topped with glowing embers and casting flickering orange light.
